name: Segmented
description:
One of two to five mutually exclusive modes ("Enabled | Disabled", "List | Grid", "RMM ·
PSA · CHAT"). A recessed glass track with a selected indicator that slides between segments.

Container-aware (R7): measured against the box it is given, it steps down from every label,
to icons only (when every option has an icon), to one menu button showing the chosen option
("RMM ▾") whose menu lists the options with a check on the chosen one. The value,
onValueChange and the group's accessible name are the same in every form.
signature: <V extends string = string>({ options, value, defaultValue, onValueChange, size, iconOnly, block, collapse: collapseProp, disabled, readOnly, invalid, tone, onBlur, className, id, ...aria }: SegmentedProps<V>): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: IDs of elements that provide the accessible name.

props.name: block
props.description: Fill the container; segments share the width equally. A block never collapses.

props.name: collapse
props.description: What happens when the options do not fit. Default: the host's SegmentedCollapseContext, else "auto".

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value when using the component without controlling its state.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction while retaining the component’s disabled appearance.

props.name: iconOnly
props.description: Show icons only; labels become accessible names. Still folds to the menu when even the icons do not fit.

props.name: id
props.description: A stable element or component identifier.

props.name: onBlur
props.description: Called with the focus event when focus leaves the whole control, not when it moves between segments. For form libraries' touched state.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the chosen option's `value` when the person picks a segment (or a menu item in the collapsed form); pressing the current segment does not deselect it. Pair with `value` to control it.

props.name: options
props.description: The available choices, including their values and visible labels.

props.name: readOnly
props.description:
Shows a recorded answer: full contrast, the chosen option marked, one tab stop that
announces the value as read-only (a radio group with `aria-readonly`). Pointer and
keyboard change nothing and there is no hover or press feedback, in every form.

props.name: size
props.description: The token-based size. Touch targets adapt to coarse pointers independently of the selected density.

props.name: tone
props.description: The chosen segment's tint. Status tones only when the modes are statuses (R3.3).

props.name: value
props.description: The controlled value. Keep it in application state and update it in the change callback.
